execution.meaning: PASS establishes observed defective behavior. Seven defects across six cases because auth/CMS case reproduces SCP-01 and SCP-04.

readiness: Not ready for independent audit; corrections and formal platform return remain pending

defects.title: Owner direct publication/history DML bypasses server gates
defects.trigger: Current active owner AAL2 directly mutates publication and history tables after accepted migrations and canonical RPC hardening.
defects.expected: Publication validation and revision checks precede atomic public snapshot/history/audit writes; approved history remains immutable.
defects.actual: Authenticated role with true owner-AAL2 predicate inserted revision999, updated arbitrary public payload and rewrote history revision1; audit count0; hardened RPC permission false.
defects.impact: Owner can bypass validation/concurrency/audit and rewrite history. No non-owner escalation demonstrated.

defects.title: Expired lease holder overwrites reclaimed worker result
defects.trigger: Worker A pauses in synthetic send; its lease expires; worker B reclaims and succeeds; A subsequently returns retryable failure.
defects.expected: Only current lease holder may finalize its claim; stale updates leave B's sent result unchanged.
defects.actual: B set sent/provider_id synthetic-provider-b; A subsequently changed row to retrying/attempts1 with cleared lease.
defects.impact: A delivered message becomes eligible for resend; production provider idempotency behavior and actual duplicate delivery were not tested.

defects.title: Fifth unexpected exception strands retrying outbox row
defects.trigger: Synthetic provider throws for claimed row already at attempts4.
defects.expected: Exhausted retries transition to failed for owner triage.
defects.actual: Catch branch stored retrying/attempts5; next run a day later claimed nothing and invoked provider0 times.
defects.impact: Notification remains indefinitely retrying despite no future eligibility.

defects.title: Truncated images accepted with fabricated dimensions
defects.trigger: Canonical validateUpload receives synthetic signature-only PNG8/JPEG3/WebP12 bytes.
defects.expected: Validate actual image dimensions and decodeability before approval; reject corrupt image payloads.
defects.actual: All accepted; all dimensions1200x800 despite no decodable image.
defects.impact: Corrupt media can enter upload/approval workflow; dimensions cannot be trusted. Hosted storage upload was not invoked.

defects.title: Telemetry code dimension conflicts with accepted SQL uniqueness
defects.trigger: Two valid renderer_failed events share date/project helios/tier low but code error_a then error_b.
defects.expected: Accepted dimensions and SQL conflict target agree; valid events aggregate successfully.
defects.actual: First canonical API request202; second503 with SQL23505 on aggregate_events_date_event_project_id_tier_key; count remained1.
defects.impact: Valid telemetry is lost when code changes for otherwise equal non-null dimensions.

defects.title: Telemetry body byte ceiling checks characters
defects.trigger: Synthetic valid telemetry body without Content-Length contains Unicode in an ignored field.
defects.expected: Body over4096 actual UTF8 bytes returns413.
defects.impact: Documented byte ceiling bypassed. No large-body stress or resource-exhaustion demonstration.

defects.title: Failed GitHub refreshes have no hourly attempt bound
defects.trigger: Expired cached repository snapshot, three requests at the same injected clock, synthetic503 upstream response.
defects.expected: Bound refresh attempts while preserving last-good data through outage/rate limit.
defects.actual: Three requests invoked synthetic fetch3 times; last-good response preserved each time.
defects.impact: Outages can cause repeated upstream requests despite hourly-refresh contract. No actual upstream calls or hosted multi-process claim.

sourceOnlyConcerns.concern: Rollback accepts only targetRevision. Publication lock serializes writes but no caller expectedRevision check protects stale-tab intent.
sourceOnlyConcerns.qualification: Exact rollback API contract needs parent decision before treating concern as assigned defect.

sourceOnlyConcerns.concern: Process-lifetime Map has no eviction/cardinality ceiling; accepted code strings create additional keys, including in production after successful SQL aggregation.
sourceOnlyConcerns.qualification: No stress test or demonstrated resource exhaustion.

notRun: Actual mail/provider delivery or duplicate behavior
